An '''unidentified 3PO-series protocol droid''' was owned by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Torbin (smuggler)|Torbin]]. The [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|droid]] was modified to have a secret compartment in its torso which was used to smuggle weaponry and illegal substances.
